title: Choose the First Artifact composition
question: All three use the approved Living Signal world and the template's visual mechanics. Choose one, combine them, or request a revision.

options.label: Centered Signal Portal
options.lineage: the supplied template's centered cinematic hero
options.thesis: The clearest conversion path: belief, proof of five members, then one application action.
options.viewport: Five member signals sit above a centered headline and wide application action; the manifesto appears as the next white fold.
options.risk: The centered stack is immediately legible but is the most familiar composition.

options.label: Asymmetric Signal Editorial
options.lineage: editorial declaration crossed with a live signal map
options.thesis: The strongest point of view: the belief owns the left side while five founders animate the right.
options.viewport: A left-aligned declaration, right-side member signal path, compact application action, and visible manifesto fold.
options.risk: Its reading rail and large asymmetry require the most careful mobile translation.

options.label: Member Signal Stage
options.lineage: cinematic signal field with a live evidence rail
options.thesis: The five founding members become the bridge between the opening belief and the manifesto.
options.viewport: A low-anchored headline and application action lead into a five-member rail and a forceful manifesto reveal.
options.risk: The evidence rail must not resemble a decorative carousel while member profiles are pending.
